brief.headline: SK Hynix 2026 HBM sold out, KOSPI concentration at 40%+ triggers forced selling despite 1,000% rally; DRAM contract +58-63% Q2
brief.summary: <cite index="8-6,8-22">SK Hynix's 2026 HBM capacity is fully sold out, with supply shortages projected to persist through 2027.</cite> <cite index="12-7,12-8">Conventional DRAM contract prices will rise 58% to 63% QoQ in Q2 2026, while NAND Flash contract prices will jump 70% to 75% QoQ, following Q1 DRAM increases of 90% to 95%.</cite> <cite index="41-5,41-12">SK Hynix surpassed $1 trillion market cap, joining Samsung in the trillion-dollar club—making South Korea the first nation outside the US to host multiple trillion-dollar companies.</cite> <cite index="41-7,41-9">The rally pushed SK Hynix and Samsung to over 40% of KOSPI weight, forcing large funds to sell despite bullish fundamentals due to concentration rules.</cite> <cite index="23-5,23-9">Hyperscalers collectively will spend roughly $700 billion on capex in 2026, nearly double the 2025 figure.</cite>
brief.pair_trade_view: <cite index="43-4,43-9,43-20">SK Hynix's market cap reached 93.2% of Samsung Electronics' as of May 29, narrowing from less than half a year ago; SK Hynix shares surged approximately 1,000% over the past year versus Samsung's 436%.</cite> <cite index="5-5,5-27">UBS predicts SK Hynix will achieve approximately a 70% market share in the HBM4 market for NVIDIA's next-generation Rubin platform in 2026.</cite> <cite index="46-8">SK Hynix held a 53% share of the HBM market in Q3 2025, compared to Samsung's 35%.</cite> Long SK Hynix / short Samsung remains the consensus relative value trade: pure HBM exposure, tighter yield control, and customer lock-in with NVDA Rubin/Blackwell Ultra offset Samsung's HBM4 qualification narrative. <cite index="40-21,40-24">Analysts see memory prices next year with ample upside, with the excess demand environment expected to persist at least through 2027.</cite> Index concentration risk materializing: forced selling by domestic funds despite bullish fundamentals creates tactical volatility, but structural demand supports both names through 2027.

memory_cycle.notes: <cite index="3-1">Goldman Sachs forecasts a 4.9% DRAM supply deficit in 2026.</cite> <cite index="5-14">Bank of America forecasts global DRAM revenue to surge by 51% and NAND by 45% YoY in 2026, with ASPs rising by 33% and 26%, respectively.</cite> <cite index="10-9">AI will consume 20% of total DRAM production in 2026.</cite> <cite index="12-9,12-10">DRAM suppliers are reallocating capacity towards AI-related applications, NAND production is increasingly being directed toward enterprise SSDs, and meaningful capacity expansion is not expected until late 2027 at the earliest.</cite> <cite index="17-3">Analysts project that the memory price rally is poised to extend past 2028.</cite> Structural supply deficit persists; HBM wafer intensity (3x DDR5) and hyperscaler capex velocity overwhelming fab ramp timelines (Samsung P5 2028, SK M15X mid-2027).

brief.hbm_pulse: <cite index="5-18,5-19">BofA estimates the 2026 HBM market to reach $54.6 billion, a 58% increase from the previous year, with Goldman Sachs forecasting HBM demand for custom-ordered, ASIC-based AI chips will skyrocket by 82%, accounting for one-third of the market.</cite> <cite index="8-1,8-25">Customers signing HBM contracts now are targeting 2027 delivery windows.</cite> <cite index="2-11,2-13">SK Hynix announced iHBM thermal architecture integrating cooling elements inside HBM interface, cutting thermal resistance by over 30%.</cite> <cite index="4-4,4-5,4-6">Korean memory manufacturers are discussing a new approach that places GPUs and HBM in separate packages connected through optical links, which could allow GPUs to support several times more HBM than existing designs.</cite> <cite index="35-1,35-2">TSMC's tight CoWoS supply is reportedly pushing SK Hynix to work with Intel on advanced packaging.</cite> HBM3E remains 2026 flagship, but HBM4 transition accelerating with SK Hynix world-first mass production system secured Sept 2025. Supply fully allocated through 2027; pricing leverage intact.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix crosses $1T market cap, 2026 HBM fully sold out
news_pulse.source: AI Weekly / CNN / Seoul Economic Daily
news_pulse.implication: Supply constraint is binding through 2027; SK Hynix pricing power intact, consolidates HBM leadership vs Samsung

news_pulse.headline: DRAM contract prices +58-63% Q2, NAND +70-75% (TrendForce)
news_pulse.implication: Sequential pricing acceleration for NAND outpaces DRAM for first time; confirms enterprise SSD tightness and cloud multi-quarter agreements

news_pulse.headline: Hyperscaler 2026 capex revised to $725B (was $670B pre-earnings)
news_pulse.implication: Demand signal stronger than expected; Meta raised FY26 to $125-145B, Alphabet Q1 alone $35.67B (+100% YoY). GPU/HBM allocations remain bottleneck

news_pulse.headline: KOSPI Samsung + SK Hynix >40% weight triggers forced fund selling
news_pulse.implication: Index concentration mechanics creating technical selling despite bullish fundamentals; volatility elevated, but structural bid intact

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix market cap reaches 93.2% of Samsung, gap now 6.8%
news_pulse.implication: SK Hynix HBM purity premium widening; Samsung HBM4 'back' narrative not yet priced, execution risk remains

news_pulse.headline: TSMC CoWoS capacity scaling to 130K wpm by end-2026 (from 35K late-2024)
news_pulse.implication: NVDA secures >60% of 2025-26 CoWoS; AMD MI350/400 and hyperscaler ASICs compete for remaining allocation. Intel EMIB emerging as overflow option

news_pulse.headline: Samsung, SK Hynix scale HBM production ~50% in 2026; OpenAI Stargate deal 900K wafers/month
news_pulse.implication: Fab build timelines (Samsung P5 2028, SK M15X mid-2027) lag demand; OpenAI contract visibility supports multi-year pricing

news_pulse.headline: Memory makers discuss GPU-HBM separation via optical links to expand capacity
news_pulse.implication: 2027+ architectural shift potential; would unbundle HBM from CoWoS constraint, but photonics miniaturization remains technical hurdle

brief.derivatives_signal: No ADR pricing, futures, or FX data in payload. KOSPI concentration mechanics (40%+ in two names) elevate gamma/vol risk; domestic funds facing forced selling creates tactical put skew opportunity. Watch USD/KRW for carry unwind risk if KOSPI corrects on tech rotation.
